subject: tf-sh
title: TF.SH.------PRI.INFO.
description: Diagram in UPB(II)-31, the first of three on book p169. (C)TF-SH (transfer shift) is crossed with PRI-INFO (primary information). Embedded in the part of the section where Braxton argues for 'creative functionalism' as carrying multi-dimensional overtones — sound as ritual, healing, communication, structural, alignment factor — and where transfer shift is defined as the cross-cultural process by which forms migrate between groups. TR (transformation) feeds TF-SH. TF-SH branches to PRI-INFO (the crossing) → COS-P (cosmic particulars) → CULT-AF-BS (culture affinity basis); to T-C-IMP (time continuum implications) → TRS (transition); and to PHY-U-P (physical universe particular), which then branches to MT-INFO (music information) and ATTN (attraction). MT-INFO further branches to APP-RDEF (applied redefinitions) and POL-P (political policies). Structural argument: transfer shift's relation to primary information passes through *cosmic particulars* into *culture affinity basis* — i.e., transfer shift only deposits primary information into a culture once its cosmic-particulars have been registered. The parallel chain through physical-universe-particulars produces music information and attraction, both of which feed into politically-and-redefinition-laden territory. Read against the section: transfer shift is not a free flow of forms — it is gated by cosmic particulars and routes its physical-universe outputs through political-policy channels.
